LanguageData.LC_Ppodae_EscapedText: {0} tore out of its fluffy disguise into a hulking frenzy beast! It will hunt nearby humanlikes with heavy Red slams until it claims a victim and curls back into a containment egg.
LanguageData.LC_Ppodae_SuppressedText: {0} has collapsed out of frenzy and reverted to its containment egg.
LanguageData.LC_Ppodae_SatedMessage: {0} slew {1}, calmed down, and curled back into a containment egg.
LanguageData.LC_Woodsman_EscapedText: {0} has stuffed a fresh human heart into its furnace and broken loose! Beware its heavy Red axe blows and keep corpses away so it cannot heal ~95 HP by consuming them.
LanguageData.LC_Woodsman_SuppressedText: {0}'s furnace has gone cold as the iron giant collapses back into its containment egg.
LanguageData.LC_Woodsman_TrapArmedMessage: {0}'s Qliphoth Counter reached 0—it now waits silently to claim the heart of the very next employee who enters its containment cell!
LanguageData.LC_Woodsman_TrapArmedInspect: WARNING: Heart trap armed — next entering worker will be executed!
LanguageData.LC_Woodsman_HeartTrapTriggered: {0} snapped shut its iron shutter, executed {1} to claim a beating heart, and breached containment!
LanguageData.LC_Cosmos_EscapedText: {0} shed its painted heart and unleashed four black tendrils! Watch out for periodic cosmic songs dealing AoE White damage.
LanguageData.LC_Cosmos_SuppressedText: {0}'s alien song fell quiet as it folded back into its containment egg.
LanguageData.LC_Scarecrow_EscapedText: {0} tore off its straw hat to harvest human intellect! Do not attack while its straw tongue drains a slain victim—it is completely invulnerable and heals rapidly while feeding.
LanguageData.LC_Scarecrow_SuppressedText: {0} crumpled into tattered cloth and straw, reverting to its containment egg.
